stem_book: [Choose one or more than one correct options] For 0 < θ < π/2, the solution(s) of Σ (m = 1 to 6) cosec(θ + (m − 1)π/4)·cosec(θ + mπ/4) = 4√2 is(are) [JEE Advanced 2009] (a) π/4 (b) π/6 (c) π/12 (d) 5π/12
work: each term = √2[cot(θ+(m−1)π/4) − cot(θ+mπ/4)] ⇒ sum = √2(cotθ − cot(θ+3π/2)) = √2(cotθ + tanθ) = 2√2/sin2θ = 4√2 ⇒ sin2θ = 1/2 ⇒ θ = π/12, 5π/12
